name: Spore burst
description:
A puffball going off. The Spore's blast borrowed ss.sfx.elite-die until now, so every cache the player set off said a large enemy had died, and its Cluster Bloom aftershocks borrowed the hit. A pod of spores bursting is neither: it is a skin giving way and a cloud coming out of it.

`skin` is the membrane splitting, the part a phone hears first: a sine snapped down from `$shell.up` to `$shell` in twenty-five milliseconds over a ten-millisecond crack of noise at `$grit`. `thud` is the weight under it, a sine falling from `$moan`, short enough to be felt rather than heard as a note. `cloud` is the spores: noise under a lowpass that opens to `$gust` as the cloud swells and closes to `$shell` as it settles, swelling in over sixty milliseconds rather than arriving, because a cloud is pushed out, not struck. `settle` is a scatter of faint grains through the back half — the spores pattering down.

The `small` variant is the same pod a third higher, for the Cluster Bloom's four daughters going off round the crater.

small.description: One of the Cluster Bloom's daughters: the same burst a third higher, so four of them round the crater read as the pod's children and not four more pods. Pitch only — a stretch would squeeze the skin's attack under the declick.
